name: run-look-back
intent: Looping in-place run with a pronounced look-back: the head begins turning behind first, the body follows while the running stride continues, then the head and body return to the initial heading to close the loop.

phases.name: baseline-run
phases.description: Baseline running before the pronounced look-back begins.

phases.name: head-led-look-back
phases.description: The head leads the look-back, building toward the strongest backward gaze.

phases.name: carried-backward-gaze
phases.description: The backward gaze is maintained while the root/body continues turning.

phases.name: unwind-and-loop-return
phases.description: The head and body unwind and restore the initial heading to return to the loop start.

keyPoses.role: head-led look-back before major root turn
forward gaze while body/root is still unwinding

weightTransfer.description: Weight alternates across successive ground contacts throughout the turn; the pelvis lowers during loading phases and rises between contacts.
weightTransfer.contactCaveat: Anatomical left/right support side is intentionally not assigned because the rotating rendered view supports the alternating load/rise pattern more strongly than a side-specific support label.

bodyMechanics.description: The head initiates the look-back before the root; the root/body follows while the head maintains the backward gaze. During the return, the head counter-rotates toward forward before the root completes restoration of the initial heading.
bodyMechanics.orientationCaveat: The reviewed orientation annotations use Z-axis twist components from the source quaternions only to compare relative turn timing between the head and root; they do not represent full Euler body orientation.

recommended: run locomotion with a head-led look-back
timing between gaze, body follow-through, and recovery while the running stride continues
